message.content: {"note_claim": "The first plane strike was captured by French filmmaker Jules Naudet while filming a documentary and aired later.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Jules captured the clearest footage of the first airplane, American Airlines Flight 11, hitting the North Tower of the World Trade Center... while filming a documentary about the FDNY. The footage shot in 2001 was made into the 2002 documentary 9/11.", "reason": "The page directly confirms that Jules Naudet captured the first impact footage while filming a documentary, and that the footage was later made into the 2002 documentary, supporting the note's claim that it was not a live broadcast but aired later."}

parsed.note_claim: The first plane strike was captured by French filmmaker Jules Naudet while filming a documentary and aired later.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Jules captured the clearest footage of the first airplane, American Airlines Flight 11, hitting the North Tower of the World Trade Center... while filming a documentary about the FDNY. The footage shot in 2001 was made into the 2002 documentary 9/11.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms that Jules Naudet captured the first impact footage while filming a documentary, and that the footage was later made into the 2002 documentary, supporting the note's claim that it was not a live broadcast but aired later.
